news.title: Military helicopters to fly over campus before Saturday football game
news.summary_en: A group of Black Hawk helicopters will fly over campus immediately prior to the 2:45 p.m. Nov. 7 football game between the University of Kansas and the University of Central Florida.

news.title: KU Endowment board elects five new trustees
news.summary_en: Five new trustees were elected to the KU Endowment board of trustees at its Annual Meeting on Oct. 23. Representing a range of professional backgrounds and areas of expertise, they bring valuable perspectives and experience to the board.

news.title: KU team plans US network for high-quality reference genome sequencing
news.summary_en: Investigators from the University of Kansas — where genomics are prioritized as a research focus — are making detailed plans for a national reference genome infrastructure with support from the National Science Foundation.

news.title: KU to celebrate first-generation Jayhawks at I Am First Too poster unveiling
news.summary_en: Twelve KU students, faculty, staff and alumni who were the first in their families to attend college will be honored at the I Am First Too Poster Unveiling Celebration from 3 to 4:30 p.m. Nov. 9 in the Kansas Union Ballroom. The Center for Educational Opportunity Programs hosts the event, which will feature a keynote address by Melissa Peterson.

news.title: KU researcher proposes techniques for communicators to recognize, avoid inherent biases in AI
news.summary_en: Mugur Geana, a professor of journalism & mass communications at KU, has contributed a chapter to a new book about the inherent biases in large language models. He proposes how communications professionals can recognize those biases and avoid repeating them in their own work.
